hints.title: Even Length Palindrome Divisibility
hints.text: All even-length palindromes except eleven are divisible by eleven and therefore cannot be prime.

hints.title: Odd Length Generator Construction
hints.text: Construct palindromes of odd lengths by mirroring half-strings around a central pivot digit.

hints.title: Trial Primality Verification
hints.text: Check candidates sequentially for primality using trial division up to square root. Skip entire even-length ranges when candidate lengths exceed two.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Constructing odd-length palindromic candidates directly avoids testing composite values.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking every sequential number for palindromic structure and primality tests millions of non-palindromes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Leverage the 11-divisibility property of even-length palindromes to skip testing them.
